all_null.sql: SELECT sum(a.v),avg(a.v),count(a.v),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k WHERE a.k=2

avg_min_max.sql: SELECT avg(a.v*b.v),min(a.v+b.v),max(a.v-b.v) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

case_decimal.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN a.v < b.v THEN a.d*b.d ELSE 0 END) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

distinct_declined.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT a.v),sum(a.v*b.v) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

duplicates_nulls.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),sum(a.d*b.d),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k

empty.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k WHERE a.k=123

grouped_declined.sql: SELECT a.k,sum(a.v*b.v) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k GROUP BY a.k ORDER BY a.k

multi_key_declined.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k AND a.v=b.v

null_safe.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.k

one_row_decimal.sql: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN y.v%3=0 THEN CAST(x.v*y.v AS DECIMAL(18,2))*1.25 ELSE 0 END) FROM x JOIN y ON x.k=y.k

one_row_resume.sql: SELECT sum(x.v*y.v),avg(x.v*y.v),min(x.v*y.v),max(x.v*y.v),count(*) FROM x JOIN y ON x.k=y.k

residual_declined.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),count(*) FROM a JOIN b ON a.k=b.k AND a.v<b.v

reversed.sql: SELECT sum(a.v*b.v),count(*) FROM b JOIN a ON a.k=b.k
